title: hoffmannseggella × cipoensis

It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and oxidative stress, due to its potential health benefits of reducing anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Hoffmannseggella × cipoensis may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
